entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.evidence_symbol: sql adapter ddl plan lowers create table ddl into typed schema plan
entries.coverage_contract: PostgreSQL-shaped catalog DDL that can affect durable schema state must lower to typed catalog/schema plans or deterministic unsupported catalog plans before execution.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Remaining destructive multi-table catalog DDL must add crash/reopen and idempotent replay evidence before its inventory row can move from plan coverage to execution parity.

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.evidence_symbol: sql adapter generated copy unsupported AST lowers to bulk io plan
entries.coverage_contract: COPY-shaped PostgreSQL syntax must either route through an explicit bulk-io plan or remain a deterministic unsupported fixture before it can affect durable table state.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Native COPY execution remains outside relational durable row mutation coverage until it has typed row ingestion, auth, row-claim, and rollback evidence.

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.evidence_symbol: postgres sql adapter insert source unique conflict executes through relational storage
entries.coverage_contract: INSERT, INSERT ... SELECT, ON CONFLICT, partial/temporal conflict targets, grouped guards, defaults, generated values, and RETURNING must have typed plans plus SQL/API execution parity or unsupported fixtures.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Hosted/provisioned owner-movement chaos for insert-source upsert remains tracked separately by the production chaos inventory.

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.evidence_symbol: postgres sql adapter merge mutation batch executes through relational storage
entries.coverage_contract: MERGE and joined mutation syntax that can update, delete, insert, or return durable rows must have generated metadata rejection, typed plans, and execution parity or unsupported fixtures.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Range-movement and remote-owner replay chaos for derived mutation-source stages remains tracked under multi-row DML slices.

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.evidence_symbol: hosted mutation source stages global planned candidates across remote owners
entries.coverage_contract: UPDATE/DELETE source syntax that claims base rows must prove typed lowering, non-lockable source rejection, owner-local staging, claim resolution, and SQL/API parity.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Live split/merge/leader handoff fairness and crash/reopen replay remain tracked under multi-row DML and queue claim slices.

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.evidence_symbol: sql auth adapter applies row security policies through user manager
entries.coverage_contract: Routine, role, grant, and row-security policy syntax that affects durable catalog or authorization state must have native runtime application evidence or deterministic unsupported fixtures.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Additional routine trigger and policy combinations must keep parser, binder, runtime, auth, and reopen evidence before being removed from compatibility inventories.

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.evidence_symbol: sql adapter lower dml lowers truncate into claimed table-emptying mutation source
entries.coverage_contract: TRUNCATE, ONLY-qualified TRUNCATE, RESTART/CONTINUE IDENTITY, multi-table barriers, and CASCADE must lower to typed table-emptying work or unsupported fixtures before durable state changes.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Combined table-emptying plus secondary-index chaos remains tracked separately by the production chaos inventory.
